core_definition: | is the operator by which one process-aspect is compared to another while preserving non-collapse sufficient for distinction generation.
reading: A compared to B under preserved distinction.
compressed_chain: Affect -> [Effect <->_xb Exclusion] -> Addition -> (Affect | Addition) -> D -> delta_alpha -> Affect'
core_claim: Distinction does not create a new process; distinction creates deviated constraint within the same process.

mud_track_interpretation.residue_reading: residue is not an added thing; it is preserved organization of the same topology

H1_bar_necessity.claim: If | is removed, D generation should collapse or sharply degrade.
H1_bar_necessity.form: not(|) -> not D or D approx 0

H2_bar_complexity.claim: Higher-order bar structures should increase admissible organization opportunities.
H2_bar_complexity.expected_result: organization_score increases when admissibility is preserved

H3_deviated_admissibility.claim: D generated from | should leave admissibility different than before.

H4_no_memory_object.claim: The observed persistence should be explainable as deviated constraint, not as a separate residue object.

primary_measurements.D_strength: magnitude or intensity of generated distinction
primary_measurements.organization_score: degree of stable organization in topology after comparison
primary_measurements.Affect_renewal_score: degree to which delta_alpha conditions the next Affect state

C1_collapse_bar.description: Comparison is forced toward identity A=B.
C1_collapse_bar.expected: D approaches zero; little admissibility deviation

C2_random_bar.description: Comparison occurs but distinction preservation is randomized.

C3_valid_bar.expected: D generation followed by measurable delta_alpha

promotion_conditions: |-enabled runs produce significantly more D than no-bar controls
delta_alpha affects the next cycle's admissibility or Affect renewal
results survive randomized and collapse-comparison controls
failure_conditions: D does not produce measurable admissibility deviation
bar complexity has no detectable organizational effect
results require a separate memory object rather than same-process deviated constraint
